# The features

**25 modules.** Generated by `npm run spec` from the registry
itself, so it lists what is mounted rather than what somebody remembered to
write down.

A feature here is a folder under `src/modules` exporting one `AppModule`. It
owns its routes, its navigation entry and its settings. Adding one is a folder
and a line in `src/registry.ts`; removing one is deleting that line.

**The order matters.** Modules are mounted in registry order, and a module that
guards `*` from `/` guards every path registered after it. That is why the two
pages a client opens with no account — `/q` and `/d` — are mounted above the
dashboard, and why a test holds them there.

| # | Module | What it is | Mounted at | Routes | In the menu |
|---:|---|---|---|---:|---|
| 1 | `auth` | Authentication | `/login`, `/logout`, `/account`, `/setup` | 18 | — |
| 2 | `search` | Search | `/search` | 1 | — |
| 3 | `landing` | Public website | `/`, `/enquiry` | 14 | — |
| 4 | `clientquote` | Quotations a client can open | `/q` | 2 | — |
| 5 | `publicdoc` | Document lists a client can open | `/d` | 1 | — |
| 6 | `shortcut` | Files sent in from a Mac or a phone | `/api/ingest/shortcut` | 1 | — |
| 7 | `dashboard` | Dashboard | `/`, `/search` | 0 | Dashboard |
| 8 | `alerts` | Alerts | `/alerts` | 1 | Alerts |
| 9 | `inbox` | Inbox | `/inbox` | 23 | — |
| 10 | `inquiries` | Inquiries | `/inquiries` | 12 | Incoming |
| 11 | `clients` | Clients | `/clients` | 26 | Clients |
| 12 | `cases` | Cases | `/cases` | 20 | Cases |
| 13 | `quotes` | Quotes | `/quotes` | 30 | Money → Quotes |
| 14 | `mail` | Sent email | `/mail` | 2 | — |
| 15 | `invoices` | Invoices | `/invoices` | 12 | Money → Invoices |
| 16 | `tasks` | Tasks | `/tasks` | 8 | Tasks |
| 17 | `calendar` | Calendar | `/calendar` | 1 | Calendar |
| 18 | `documents` | Documents | `/documents` | 6 | — |
